summary: SambaNova's official rate limits policy confirms a Free Tier that is applied automatically to any account without a linked payment method, alongside a Developer Tier for accounts with a payment method. Free Tier access is rate-limited per model: production models (DeepSeek-V3.1, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, gpt-oss-120b) and preview models (DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it) each get 20 requests/minute, 20 requests/day, and 200,000 tokens/day. The cloud dashboard shows the claim path: sign up, create an API key, and call the OpenAI-compatible API. No fixed end date is stated anywhere, so the offer is ongoing.
claim_steps: Go to https://cloud.sambanova.ai/ and create an account via Login/Signup.
Do not link a payment method — per the rate limits policy, the Free Tier is applied when there is no payment method linked with your account.
From the dashboard, open API Keys and create an API key.
Call the OpenAI-compatible API with your bearer key (https://api.sambanova.ai/v1/chat/completions). Free Tier limits: 20 requests/minute, 20 requests/day, 200,000 tokens/day per model.
